pattern: A select-only combobox (a button element with role=combobox and aria-haspopup="dialog") opens a non-modal dialog (WAI-ARIA APG Dialog, non-modal variant) that holds a search box and one WAI-ARIA APG Listbox per level. Levels behave like the columns of a column browser: Up and Down move within a level, the inline arrow keys move between levels. A tree view was not used because only one branch per level is shown at a time.

roles.role: combobox on a button element (aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded)

aria.value: the label and the selected path text
required, shown validation state, help and error
true when readOnly (the popup does not open)
the active option of the level
true on the selected path (multiple: on selected paths)

keyboard.action: Open the popup (focus goes to the search box, or the first level).
Move within the level (disabled options are skipped).
Open the active node's children in the next level (loading them when needed) and move there.
Select a leaf (or a node with changeOnSelect); otherwise open its children.
Select a leaf; open a node's children.
Move into the results (or the levels when the box is empty).
Close and return focus to the trigger.
Search box, then the levels; tabbing out closes the popup.

focus: Opening moves focus into the popup; selecting (single) or Escape returns it to the trigger. Only the current level is in the tab sequence. Removing a chip moves focus to the next chip's remove button, or to the trigger.
notes: Nodes with children carry a visually hidden "has more levels" text, because options cannot expose aria-expanded.
Selections, removals, loading, and load errors are announced; load errors offer a Retry button that receives focus.
Give levelLabels so each listbox is named (Country, State, City).
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
